title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security update
description: A critical security update has been issued for the Linux kernel packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.8. The update addresses two vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-98432, which fixes improper freeing of inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period, and a local privilege escalation vulnerability related to improper ownership management in skb_zerocopy. These kernel vulnerabilities could impact system security due to the kernel's fundamental role. The update requires a system reboot to take effect.
